annotations.title: Find deployments similar to your use case

description: Describe a use case you have in mind, in a sentence or a short paragraph (what the AI does, for whom, on what data), and get the most similar real deployments in the hub, ranked by embedding similarity. Each result has a Similarity score from 0 to 1, the original source (Url) and its hub page (HubUrl). Optional industry, country and cloud_provider narrow the comparison. Use this for 'who has already built something like this?' questions; for keyword lookups use search_usecases.

cloud_provider.description: Only compare with deployments on this provider, for example Microsoft, AWS, GCP, Databricks or OpenAI.

country.description: Only compare with deployments in this country, for example US or DE.

description.description: The use case you have in mind, up to 1,000 characters.

industry.description: Only compare with deployments in this industry.

limit.description: How many similar cases to return, for example 5, 10 or 20. Public previews return at most 3; personal-key access permits up to 20.

name: find_similar_usecases
